title: Multi-chart Dashboard
content: Build dashboard with various chart types. Chart grid: responsive grid of chart widgets. Chart types: line, bar, pie, area, doughnut. Legends: clear chart legends. Tooltips: hover tooltips with details. Interactivity: click to drill down. Loading: skeleton charts while loading. Responsive: charts resize appropriately. variants.simple: Create dashboard with multiple chart types displaying data.
variants.detailed: Build dashboard with various chart types. Chart grid: responsive grid of chart widgets. Chart types: line, bar, pie, area, doughnut. Legends: clear chart legends. variants.advanced: Build comprehensive multi-chart analytics dashboard. Grid layout: responsive CSS grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3), chart cards with consistent styling. Chart card component: white bg, rounded-xl, shadow-sm, p-4-6, title header, chart area, optional footer with actions. Chart types: Line (time series, trends), Area (stacked for composition over time), Bar (comparisons, rankings), Horizontal Bar (for long labels), Pie/Donut (part-to-whole), Radar (multi-variable comparison), Scatter (correlation). Chart library: Recharts for React, or Victory, Chart.js. Common styling: consistent color palette across all charts, same fonts, axis styling, legend positioning. Responsive charts: ResponsiveContainer wrapper, charts resize with container. Tooltips: custom tooltip component with card styling, show relevant metrics on hover. Legends: positioned below or right based on chart type, clickable to toggle series visibility. Interactions: click bar/pie slice for drilldown, zoom on line charts, selection for time ranges. Loading states: skeleton chart matching aspect ratio, or pulse placeholder. Error handling: error message in chart area with retry. Refresh: individual chart refresh button, auto-refresh interval option. Global date range: selector affects all charts, pass range as prop to each. Chart fullscreen: expand single chart to full screen for detailed view. Download: each chart has download as PNG/SVG option. Dashboard configuration: optional drag and drop reordering of chart positions, save layout preference. Dark mode: chart colors adapt to dark theme.
